name: Bjursjön - Metsjö
routeType: linear point-to-point official stage from Bjursjön to Metsjö, mostly on dirt roads and forest paths through Bjursjön, Havskuren, Ålslån and Herrestadsfjället; no ferry, rowboat or official alternate geometry found; endpoints are car/taxi oriented rather than public-transport endpoints

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: 14. Bjursjön - Metsjö
keyFacts: Official WST title is 14. Bjursjön - Metsjö; page H1 often drops the stage number.
Official WST slug is 14-bjursjon-metsjo.
Official direction is Bjursjön to Metsjö.
Official distance is 13 km / 13000 m.
Official estimated time is 4 h.
Official difficulty is red / hard.
Surface is dirt roads and forest paths.
Official start is [58.384636, 11.967494] and official end is [58.426525, 11.844436].
WST says neither Bjursjön nor Metsjö can be reached by public transport.
Route starts at Bjursjön, climbs from lowland forest through Havskuren marsh into Herrestadsfjället's open rocky/heath-like uplands.
Route passes Hällerstugan and Krokestugan; WST also calls out Kåtan by Västra Krokevattnet and Åleslån/Ålslån.
WST says fishing is free in Bjursjön, while mountain lakes require fishing licence.
caveats: WST route prose says Krokestugan at the end of the trail stage by Västra Krokevattnet; official endpoint is Metsjö, so treat Krokestugan as near-end facility rather than endpoint.
WST page says Åleslån while WST place/municipality sources use Ålslån; alias both and prefer Ålslån for facility matching.

Captured Bjursjön, Ålslån, Hällerstugan, Kåtan, Krokestugan, Metsjön and off-route/pending/suppress facility records with water and fire caveats.
